widgets_values: A vibrant, fashion-forward portrait of a young woman exuding confidence and style. She wears a mustard yellow knit beanie paired with a matching thick turtleneck scarf, which adds warmth and a playful pop of color. Her oversized transparent glasses frame her expressive eyes, while bold red lipstick adds a striking contrast to her look. She is dressed in a textured teal coat, further enhancing the bright and cozy palette of the outfit. The background features a soft pastel blue tone with clean lines, giving the composition a modern, artistic feel. Her poised expression, along with the interplay of bold colors and textures, captures a trendy, urban aesthetic.
